decisionScope: Evidence Contract capability discovery, version negotiation, handshake binding, and consumer replay surfaces

repositoryEvidence.observation: The package exposes cmi and cmi-mcp executables; there is no separate contract discovery or negotiation executable.
The current CLI adapter exposes session, finding, and evaluation workflows without an Evidence Contract version selection or discovery option.
The current MCP tool inventory exposes project/session/evaluation intelligence and no Evidence Contract discovery or negotiation method.
The documented integration surface is CLI, MCP, durable evidence, and Skills; no production Evidence Contract negotiation workflow is documented.
Negotiation remains explicitly simulation-only and runtimeNegotiationImplemented is false.
Capability advertisement remains explicitly simulation-only and runtime capability advertisement is false.
Handshake/TOCTOU binding remains a test-harness specification rather than a production API.

externalObservation.note: This observation supports the decision but is not treated as a durable runtime invariant; future demand must trigger re-evaluation.

reEvaluationTriggers: A named production consumer requests or requires Evidence Contract version discovery or exact negotiation.
CMI supports a second Evidence Contract version in production.
A real interoperability failure is observed that a fixed-v1 consumer cannot resolve safely.
An external integration needs to distinguish supported Evidence Contract versions before consuming evidence.
